On the flip side, this has allowed us to be versatile, but it also steals our ability to create and innovate effectively.. The hope for a better Nigeria is always looking like a mirage.. If we've got the opportunity to better our lives somewhere else, it's no crime. After all, all our so called leaders can run anywhere anytime.
